definitions.explanation: The part of a chair, sofa, or seat designed to support the arm. Found on office chairs, airplane seats, theater seats, and sofas.

examples.english: I rested my arm on the armrest of the chair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肘掛|ひじか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}った→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧。
examples.english: I fought over the armrest with the person sitting next to me on the plane.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{肘掛|ひじか}け⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち}→座り心地：10669_suwarigokochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧にくい。
examples.english: This armchair is comfortable and doesn't tire you out even during long work sessions.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧ (elbow) and {掛|か}け (rest/support). Refers to the part of a chair or seat designed to support the arm.
